purpose: Embedding dependency correctness and bounded real-provider qualification; no equivalent-task speedup claim
accounting: Native includes guardian and observer at payload exit. Controller snapshots before final exit are separate and partial; sum of separate peaks is not simultaneous memory. Final removed-scope counters, Docker daemon/containerd/system-manager costs and actual model usage are unknown. Aborted observations remain null. Admission is excluded from stage elapsed and recorded separately. No zero-host-OOM claim.

token_estimates.scope: Offline serialization estimates, one full catalog, named tool arguments and raw replies once each; replies may contain both text and structured copies. CLI rows include selected arguments and stdout. Actual model usage, initialization/protocol framing, prompts, host schema filtering/replay, rendering, independent oracle context and pre-transcript/in-flight failures are unmeasured. Failed and incomplete attempts retained as lower bounds. Provider qualification, not an agent investigation benchmark.

native_validation_runtime_bridge_manifes.scope: All regular dist and bridge files; canonical sorted-key compact JSON manifest hash

cancellation_followup_scope: Later doctor cancellation propagation changes only the cancelled-probe branch. Native success measurements belong to pinned commit0c70be0030; follow-up boundary/CI validation is recorded on the PR. No final-head native rerun is claimed.
